messages:
Zane: quick async check-in — ran full eval on synthia-v2 against promptset A (1k samples). Overall perf down ~4% vs baseline, hit by generation loops on long-context examples. logs: https://console.redwood.ai/runs/2823
Maya: saw the same on my Spanish batch. hallucination rate up for date extraction prompts, snippets attached.
Oliver: noted. I reproduced a repeat-token loop on quantized build (tinyq-4b). minimal repro below: 
```
python repro.py --model tinyq-4b --seq 2048 --prompt "extract dates"
# process stalls at token id 0 repeating
```
Kim: PR #432 (kv-cache boundary fix) is ready for review — this might help the loop for long-context. pinging @Oliver for review when you have a sec.
Oliver: @Kim I can take a pass in ~20m. if it's small we'll ship canary.
Maya: suggestion for rollout: canary to 5% traffic + prompt-level guard for >200 tokens: fallback to short-context variant. I'll push promptset changes after review.
Eva: kicked off a smoke eval job for the canary setup, ETA ~1.5h. dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/evals/549. I'll post a summary when done.
Zane: fyi I toggled batching config to reduce latency jitter earlier — that might affect caching behavior; rolling it back is trivial if needed.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-45 — regen loop observed on synthia-v2. Assigned to @Oliver.
Oliver: taking INC-2026-45. grabbing failing examples into a gist and will triage root cause (quantization path vs kernel selection). gist: https://gist.github.com/oliver/regen-examples
Maya: blocking item — we need an eval metric that flags repeat loops automatically (count identical tokens in sliding window). I can add it to the eval harness if folks agree.
Kim: agree, that metric would have caught this earlier. I'll add a quick alert rule in the console.
Zane: I'll do a manual translation QA pass at 16:00 PST — can check Spanish regressions Maya mentioned.
Eva: no other blockers from infra side. will update the eval job status once results are in.
Oliver: quick note: if PR #432 looks clean, I'll deploy to canary and attach fallback to rtdb-model for 5% -> if errors spike, automatic rollback.
Maya: pairing with @Kim this afternoon to tighten prompt guards and add the repeat-token metric.
Kim: thx all :thumbsup:
